subject: SIG subprocessor census for upcoming AtlasCloud assessment
messages:
From: Olivia Stone <olivia.stone@atlascloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@atlascloud.com
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: SIG subprocessor census for upcoming assessment

Hi Karthik,

Hope youre well. As part of AtlasClouds SIG review window next month, our security team is collecting a full census of subprocessors from critical vendors. Could you please provide a list of Redwoods current subprocessors covering: cloud infra (IaaS/PaaS), telemetry/analytics, error reporting, support/chat, identity/provisioning, backup/storage, and payroll/HR?

For each vendor wed like:
- Vendor name and primary contact
- Service category (cloud/telemetry/support/etc.)
- Data types processed (PII, logs, telemetry, payment metadata)
- Countries/regions where data is stored or where processing occurs
- Contract start date (approx)
- Any sub-processor chaining (i.e., vendors they themselves use)

Target deadline is end of day Nov 12 so our questionnaire (SIG) can be updated before the assessment. If you already have a CSV or export, a stub file with the columns above is perfect.

Thanks in advance — if it helps I can take a quick phone call to clarify scope.

Best,
Olivia Stone
Program Manager, Third-Party Risk
AtlasCloud

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Hi Olivia,

Thanks for the note — we can provide that. Quick clarifying question: do you need all historical subprocessors going back to 2024, or just the current (active) set? Also, do you want contract versions/redactions included, or just the vendor names + services?

Plan from our side: Ill coordinate with Ops and Legal, consolidate an export, and aim to send a first-pass CSV by EOD Nov 9. Monica will review for contractual redactions. Vivek, FYI for telemetry details.

If anything changes on your timeline, please let us know.

-Karthik

Subject: Subprocessor census export (first-pass)
Attachments: redwood_subprocessors_20261108.csv (text/csv), sig_evidence_readme_20261108.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Olivia and team,

Please find attached a first-pass export of Redwoods active subprocessors. Highlights/notes:
- Cloud infra: AWS (us-east-1, us-west-2) and Google Cloud Platform (europe-west1) listed with primary contacts.
- Telemetry/analytics: Datadog (logs/metrics), Segment (usage analytics). Weve noted that Datadog receives anonymized request traces by default; full request payloads are only sent when debugging is enabled (rare).
- Support: Intercom handles user-facing tickets and metadata; Intercom agents do not receive raw user-uploaded files.
- Backup/storage: S3 buckets are encrypted with customer-managed keys (KMS).
- Payroll/HR: Deel (payroll vendor) is listed; HR records are stored in EU by default for EU employees.

Redactions: we removed contract-specific SLA percentiles and internal pricing before sharing; Legal says these fields are not required for the SIG census. If AtlasCloud needs contract excerpts, we can coordinate via an NDA/secure share.

Attachments included: the CSV has columns for vendor, category, data_types, primary_contact, regions, contract_start, subprocessor_chain_note. The README includes mapping guidance to the SIG questionnaire fields and column definitions.

Next steps: if you want the CSV exported as a SIG-compatible spreadsheet (matching your template), we can reformat and push to the Drive link in your questionnaire.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Manager, Customer Success Ops
Redwood Inference

Monica / Karthik,

Thanks for the quick turn. The CSV and readme are exactly what we needed for the SIG intake. Couple small follow-ups: could you add an explicit column for "support access level" that indicates whether Support vendors have read/write access to production data or only metadata/diagnostic logs? Also, for Datadog and S3 backups, can you call out which AWS regions the logs/backups are stored in (were specifically tracking eu-west-1 and us-east-1)?

We do not need contract redactions at this stage — the information above will enable our mapping. If convenient, could you drop an updated CSV to the Drive link I sent (or reply here)? Target for this minor follow-up: EOD Nov 10.

Appreciate it,
Olivia
